overview: In 2024, an unidentified young man causes a heinous crime in Shibuya, Tokyo. Nakagawa Aoi, a weekly magazine writer, suspects that the perpetrator of the crime might be a former high school classmate. This leads her to reconnect with old friends she had lost touch with. While reflecting on her high school days, she pursues the truth behind the crime.
title: Invisible Us

overview: Release the Hounds is a British television show broadcast on ITV2 since October 2013. It is hosted by Reggie Yates and culminates in the participants being chased by dogs in the hope of winning a large cash prize.
title: Release the Hounds

overview: Accused of his sister's murder, Yehia is fiercely determined to seek vengeance and unmask the true perpetrator.
title: Echoes of the Past

overview: Celtics City chronicles the history, cultural impact, and extraordinary tale of the NBA's winningest and most storied franchise, the Boston Celtics, the current 2024 NBA Champion. The series contains extensive, never-before-seen archives and more than 80 interviews of past and present Boston Celtics legends – from Bob Cousy and Larry Bird to Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown.
title: Celtics City

overview: After the Fu family's massacre, only the daughter, Fu Zhaoxue survives, but the evidence points to her former lover, Gu Jingzhou. Returning with a new face as Lin Qianyu, she marries into the Gu family to uncover their secrets, reigniting a forbidden romance with Gu Jingzhou. As truths unfold, love and old grudges resurface, leading to an intense rekindling of feelings.
title: Ms. Nirvana

overview: Explore ancient Western cities with Dr. Jordan Peterson & experts in a 5-part series, uncovering their impact on the modern world.
title: Foundations of the West

overview: Time traveler Chi Yuan thought it was just a sweet love mission, only to find herself entangled in Shen Zhaomu's revenge plan! To fulfill both 'love' and 'revenge' missions, they face storms of blood and tears, life and death twists, and ultimately find true love!
title: Love Endless Eternally

overview: Invited experts dispel common stereotypes and talk about modern methods of treatment and prevention of exacerbations of mental illnesses. The heroes share the attitude of those around them - relatives, friends, society - to their diagnosis, and talk about how they managed to adapt, what difficulties they overcome daily and their plans for further combating the disease.
title: Со всеми бывает

overview: The Secret Lives of Animals highlights 77 unique species in 24 countries over three years, revealing stunning, never-before-seen animal behaviors and highlighting the remarkable intelligence of the natural world.
title: The Secret Lives of Animals

overview: Elli Anne wakes up with bruises after a party, while Issát fears his secret could ruin everything. Rumors swirl, and the silence must be broken.
title: Oro jaska

overview: Series following detectives investigating cases that remained unsolved for years and decades, and the stories of how they delivered long-overdue justice.
title: Cold Cases Reopened

overview: A long-running daytime magazine show co-hosted by two presenters live on weekdays since 1988. Features news and topical items, celebrity guests, expert advice, real life stories, competitions and a mix of cookery, health, beauty, lifestyle and more.
title: This Morning
Il était une fois dans le trouble

overview: Driven by a soul-baring interview with Paul Reubens, the man behind the iconic character Pee-wee Herman, Pee-wee as Himself is the definitive portrait of the comedic performer, and a window into his never before discussed personal life. Determined to correct the record and tell the factual story of his life, Reubens excavates his kaleidoscopic influences, origins in the circus and avant-garde performance theater, and career choices, while reflecting on the reasoning behind, and the consequences of, severing his beloved alter ego from his authentic self.
title: Pee-wee as Himself

overview: The Road offers viewers a backstage pass into the gritty and unforgiving life of a touring artist. With exclusive access to the behind-the-scenes workings of the music industry, viewers will see what happens when some of the best up-and-coming performers pile into a tour bus and tackle a grueling schedule in pursuit of their dreams.
title: The Road

overview: Jack van Doorn, the rich and notorious founder of the coffee shop empire Jackal, has had to fight his entire career against criminals, competitors, and absurd Dutch laws to become the biggest of them all. When his affair with a well-known journalist comes to light, it turns out that his most dangerous enemy has been living under his roof all this time: his betrayed wife, Betty, an ex-pop diva who knows all his weak spots and secrets and will not rest until she has taken everything from him. Amsterdam Empire is an extravagant crime drama full of glamour and grime at the heart of the Amsterdam cannabis scene.
title: Amsterdam Empire

overview: Hein, an eleven-year-old boy, is captivated by his grandfather's unconventional job – caring for a cemetery. When Hein spends his summer at the graveyard, he discovers he has supernatural powers to speak to the spirits. He is not afraid when he is befriended by the spirits to help them wrap up unfinished dealings in the world. It becomes his mission to bring guidance and messages to the spirits and their loved ones, while learning about the power of compassion and living our lives the best way we can.
title: Hein

overview: To wear the rap crown, you'll need to rule the stage. Brazilian rappers face off in this competition featuring Djonga, Filipe Ret, Tasha and Tracie.
title: Nova Cena

overview: A sudden stroke of fortune changes everything! Migrant worker Li Gouwa steps into the world of the wealthy, not for riches, but to seek justice for his brother. However, what he stumbles upon is a carefully planned murder. His arrival ignites a fierce inheritance battle within Dongcan Group, where the three Zhang brothers scheme and fight for control. Playing the fool while hiding his true strength, Li Gouwa dives deep into a whirlpool of conspiracies. Facing ruthless opponents, he survives against all odds, turning the tables time and again. In the end, driven by justice, he topples the elite and breaks free from the deadly trap.
title: Legal Boy

overview: The morning after the wedding, Dina wakes up and realizes that she doesn't know her husband. Moreover, she doesn't remember the events of the last year at all! Relatives and doctors calm the girl down, attributing everything to severe stress. Meanwhile, Dina decides to figure everything out herself.
title: Наваждение

overview: Gold Logie award-winner Rove McManus hosts Rove Live. Rove's no longer the newest kid on the talk show block -- he's a seasoned professional, able to match wits with the best in the business. Regular segments on Rove Live include Two Minutes @ Your House, Roving with Rove, Flick Your Switch, My Charader, and the ever-popular What The...?. The show also makes creative use of its database of willing Live List members who volunteer to have their lives interrupted on air. And let's not forget a guest list comprising the biggest names Rove can lay his hands on, each and every week.
title: Rove Live

overview: During the war between Sheng and Yu kingdoms, Sheng was defeated. On her deathbed, the Sheng princess tasked her maid, Ayue, to impersonate her, marry for peace, and steal Yu's defense map. Meanwhile, in Yu, Prince Chu Ruheng, branded a "rebellious son," seeks the truth behind his mother's mysterious death. A "fake princess" and a "disgraced prince" cross paths in a treacherous palace. Amid suspicion and love, they join forces to uncover secrets and fight for peace.
title: Love in the Crossfire

overview: This is a story about a family trying to survive a terrible grief. The father works in the police, the mother is an ambulance doctor. Both are rarely at home, so high school student Egor has to stay with his brother, who suffers from a severe form of cerebral palsy. One of these days, a tragedy occurs, which, it seemed, could not be worse.
title: Маяк

overview: Lyceum teacher Rita begins to be stalked online. The stalker hits her where it hurts: work, students, family, and self-confidence. Rita tries to understand: who is this person and what does he want? But there are too many people around her who would like to turn her life into a nightmare.
title: Фейк

overview: A talented student, the life of the party, a handsome athlete. Tyoma is twenty, and everything is great for him. At home, too, everything is idyllic, because Vika is not just his mother, but his best friend, his support and his ideal woman. But suddenly, there is alarming and very "adult" news that destroys the hero's ideal world. Now, in order to understand how to live on, both Vika and Tyoma will have to realize a simple thought: they both need to grow up.
title: Мамин сын

overview: In three episodes, the mothers of the most famous maniacs talk about their sons: about their birth and growing up. How did the Bitsevsky maniac come into the world, was the Penza cannibal a vegetarian, and how has the mother of the Kopeysky strangler been trying to justify her son for 20 years?
title: Как вырастить маньяка?

overview: How does a Northern Irish teen become one of the world's worst online child sex abusers? Victims, families and police share how catfish killer Alexander McCartney was caught.
title: Teen Predator/Online Killer

overview: Lieutenant-Colonel Zsolt Győrbíró is trying to correct an old mistake in a new NATO mission, while also trying to hold his own as a father and husband. His situation is not made easier by his old teammate, Colonel Tibor Horváth, who is playing with all his strength - if necessary, even with questionable means - to have Zsolt declared unfit to lead the mission. The life of the younger Győrbíró, the reluctant medical student Marci, is also changed by the basic training, to which her explosive father sends her as a punishment. However, the unexpected adventure makes a new man out of the boy, who finds not only a new profession, but also love. I wonder how the mission team is assembled, who manages to get to Iraq, what happened to their teammate in the past, and will the special military unit of S.E.R.E.G. be successful in the "revenge campaign"? A series about a sniper soldier who was forced to work in an office after a failed mission in Iraq years ago, but now he gets a new chance: he can go into the field again. His situation is complicated by his bad relationship with Link's university son, as well as by his fellow soldier who considers him incompetent, but in the end he successfully trains a sniper platoon, with whom he goes on a mission again, putting an end to his failed mission five years earlier.
title: S.E.R.E.G.

overview: Plötzlich Papa – Einspruch abgelehnt! (Suddenly Papa - rejected opposition) is a legal drama, based on the private broadcaster Sat.1 aired. The series was broadcast on Thursdays at 20:15 clock. The mission was set of 13 episodes due to very poor rates by only. 8The remaining episodes were the end of 2012 on Sat.1 Emotions erstausgestrahlt.
title: Plötzlich Papa – Einspruch abgelehnt!

overview: Join Derek in the Milkshake Studio, where he teaches us the dance moves to some of his favourite songs, with the help of Shake, the Milkshake music speaker!
title: Milkshake! Movers

overview: This marketplace highlights Black-owned and inclusive brands across various product categories. Just in time for the holiday season, Shop With BET offers a unique shopping experience for BET's audience, featuring selected items that celebrate Black founders, small businesses, and culturally inclusive products. This platform underscores BET's commitment to promoting equity and representation, making commerce more accessible, seamless, and culturally relevant.
title: Shop With BET

overview: Australia's most prestigious celebration of musical talent, with a special presentation on Channel 9 and 9Now.
title: The ARIA Music Awards

overview: Each episode of the program features witty sketches featuring popular artists. Mikhail Galustyan, Stanislav Duzhnikov, Georgy Dronov, Maria Kravchenko, Maxim Lagashkin, Alexey Maklakov, Svetlana Permyakova, Marina Fedunkiv, Maxim Kiselev, Ivan Pyshnenko and other artists of different genres will tell you what one seventh of the land lives on, and they will do it funny. "The Big Country Show" is about Russia and for Russia.
title: Шоу большой страны

overview: A family saga about ordinary residents of Alma-Ata during the difficult period of the 90s. Family stories echo the history of the country. The modest life of yesterday's public sector workers and the luxurious apartments of the new Russians and Kazakhs. How to get used to a new life without losing humanity?
title: Перекресток

overview: The participants of the game must guess the most common answers of ordinary people to simple questions that cannot be answered unambiguously. For example, "What food do the French like most?" The answers are usually completely unpredictable and funny. You can be sure that ten out of a hundred random passers-by think that janitors maintain order in the country. And imagine how many answer options there are to the questions "What does a woman do when her heel breaks?" or "What insects are most often killed?" "Battle of the Minds" is a team game. Each player must express their opinion, offer their version, but victory or defeat goes to the whole team. Most often, the selection is based on professional criteria, but popular singers, actors, and athletes often take part in it. Two teams compete on the court, the whole process consists of five "games" - simple, double, triple, reverse game and big game.
title: Битва умов

overview: Blind Date is a British dating game show produced by London Weekend Television for ITV & was hosted by Cilla Black. It ran on Saturday nights from 30 November 1985 to 31 May 2003. The show had a format similar to the show known in Australia as 'Perfect Match' or in the US as 'The Dating Game'. Three singles of the same sex were introduced to the audience. They were then questioned by a single of the opposite sex, who could hear but not see them, to choose with whom to go on a date. Before the decision 'Our Graham' (replaced on the final series by Tommy Sandhu), who was never seen, gave an amusing reminder of each contestant. The couple then picked an envelope naming their destination. The following episode showed the couple on their date, and interviews with them about the date and about each other.
title: Blind Date

overview: A talent show, whose participants demonstrate their unique abilities to the entire country. The project's motto is not to lose heart and remain bright and unrivaled, despite difficult times. In each qualifying round, 11 participants will fight for a place in the final. And only if all jury members approve of the performance and all three stars light up, the participant goes further. Each jury member has a golden button. Only once during the entire project, they can use it to let a participant through to the final, for whom not all the judges voted, and give him a chance to earn the main prize - three million rubles. In the first qualifying round: pancake juggling, push-ups on nails, fingerboarding, tongue twisters and much more.
title: Я почти знаменит

overview: Out of hundreds of applicants from all over the country, only 16 people made it to Startuppers. Some have invented an engine, some have an idea to open an atypical theater, others dream of winning the hearts of viewers with their culinary startups, and some want to become a producer of their own music label. The Startuppers show will show whose projects will see the light of day, and who will turn the page with a business idea. The participants will have to fight for a meeting with investors ready to help develop the brightest startup project! In the meantime: creative tests for stress resistance and business acumen, overcoming oneself, meetings with star guests, master classes, competitive struggle, the bitterness of defeats and the taste of the first victories.
title: Стартаперы

overview: As a result of a terrible personal drama, Lizaveta Zaretskaya developed the ability to read other people's thoughts. She was always on the way to this. But only great grief opened a certain shutter in her consciousness. After the disappearance of her only daughter Dasha, Liza's life turned into hell. And only her work in the department for the search for people keeps her in this world. And also a weak hope of finding Dasha...
title: Голоса

overview: Mikhail and Denis Demirov work in the department for searching for missing persons. The brothers are absolutely not alike - neither in character, nor in habits, nor in their attitude to life. Psychologist Rita Vysotskaya comes to work in their department. And soon both brothers find themselves drawn into a complex love triangle. Mikhail and Denis do not realize that Rita has a secret. The girl works in the department with one goal - she wants to "find herself": Rita does not know her real name, she remembers herself only from the moment she was hit by a car in a small provincial town
title: Выхожу тебя искать

overview: In the city of N-sk, the governor's daughter dies under mysterious circumstances. Investigator Oleg Nesterov arrives from Moscow to N-sk to find out the circumstances of her death. In the place where the girl's body was found, a role-playing game based on the Karelian-Finnish epic "Kalevala" was taking place, and the chairwoman of the role-players, Vera, simultaneously begins her own investigation. However, new victims and a series of mysterious events confuse Oleg and Vera more and more. And soon Nesterov realizes that role-players are not the only ones playing in N-sk. The banker, the prosecutor, and the governor are all involved in some strange gambling game, the meaning of which is hidden from the uninitiated.
title: Седьмая руна

overview: The young Soviet republic is invested by a number of "white" armies. Inside Moscow there are armies of criminal outcasts. Newly created Moscow Criminal Investigation Department tries to make a difference under this conditions.
title: Господа-товарищи

overview: Quentin, a small-time employee of a urinal company, witnesses a murder during an inspection at a gas station. He meets Blanche, a contract killer working for an application called Knok. Now an inconvenient witness, Quentin has no choice but to become a hitman himself, working in tandem with Blanche.
title: Knok

overview: Nadya lives in the village with her parents. One day she meets a Muscovite, Vitaly Bolshakov, and immediately falls in love with the young and promising guy. Despite having a fiancé at home, the girl is determined to conquer the capital and the heart of her new lover. Meanwhile, in Moscow, Vitaly has his own life, work, and beloved woman. The persistent Nadya is not ready to just give him up to another, so she intends to do everything in her power to win her place in the sun. But will this bring her happiness?
title: Долгий путь домой

overview: Vera considers herself a happy woman who has a loving husband, a good home and prosperity. Everything in her life is peaceful and smooth until trouble comes to the house. The heroine's husband, a successful businessman Dmitry, dies in an accident. Now Vera is a widow. She has to cope with difficulties herself, manage the business and support her mother-in-law. But troubles never come alone - it turns out that her deceased husband had a mistress, Yulia, and she is pregnant! Moreover, her mother-in-law, whom Vera treats like a mother, suddenly begins to take care of Yulia and eventually declares that she will not abandon her grandson - after all, he is "the only blood relative in this world." It is strange, but it is in these far from rosy circumstances that the heroine begins her path to true female happiness.
title: Чужая женщина

overview: Freakshow is an American unscripted reality documentary television series from AMC that chronicles the operations of former music producer Todd Ray's Venice Beach Freakshow. The series premiered on February 14, 2013, preceded by the mid-season premiere of Comic Book Men and followed by the series premiere of Immortalized. The show was given a greenlight along with Immortalized on August 16, 2012. It was announced in April 2013 that the series had been renewed for a second season, which premiered on May 6, 2014.
title: Freakshow

overview: The program "Yesterday Live" turned the templates and stereotypes that the modern viewer is accustomed to on their head. The objects of ridicule were a variety of television genres covering local and international events, cinema, social life, sports, etc. The name itself sounds paradoxical.
title: Yesterday Live

overview: Magic tricks are a form of art that amazes both small children and adults. Illusionists sometimes do the impossible, and to do this they use incredible sleight of hand and the ability to act quietly and quickly. Hosts Alexey and Nazar invite celebrity guests to their place in order to make them doubt what they have seen. A popular performer whose money disappears in an unknown direction, a comedian whose passport will be mercilessly destroyed by fire, a famous blogger whose license will be confiscated, and many others come here. At the end of the episode, a winner is determined, and the magician who received the fewest votes suffers an unexpected punishment.
title: Чё по фокусам?

overview: Healer Qu Zhen and Prince Rong Jin Sheng join forces to combat a deadly poison spreading through Dasheng. As they face misunderstandings, assassins, and political intrigue, Qu Zhen's skill and determination are tested. Together, they journey through perilous lands, seeking a cure and uncovering dark secrets that threaten the empire.
title: Ancient Forensic Expert

overview: They have no special education, but sometimes they act more confidently than experienced psychologists. They make you feel euphoria and delight, and also pain and fear. They hide behind high positions, present diamonds and offer to start a joint business. Relationships with them are exciting, but in the end the "lovers" inevitably find out that they were deceived. Four lonely women who fell into the traps of romantic swindlers will tell their stories.
title: MONEYпуляторы

overview: An 80-million robbery shakes the bank in the Republican era. Cheng Ru's father dies in the heist, and to uncover the truth behind his death, Cheng Ru becomes a nightclub singer and approaches the Chamber of Commerce president, Yan Liang. As their power struggle intensifies, their feelings for each other begin to grow. Meanwhile, Cheng Ru uncovers her fiancé Cheng Feng's secret, and the mystery deepens.
title: Behind the Scenes

overview: Pearl Hotel once stood on an execution ground from the late Qing Dynasty, shrouded in heavy, ominous energy. A blood-soaked peachwood sword was hidden within the hotel to ward off evil spirits. Rural newcomer Ma Xiaodao takes on the role of security guard at this infamous hotel, but he accidentally shatters the sword, drawing the scorn and anger of the building's strange residents. Soon, bizarre occurrences begin to spiral out of control throughout the hotel…
title: Pearl Hotel
À Musée vous, À Musée moi

overview: A mother escapes from a harsh Boer community to find her daughter, who is being held prisoner by the Zulus. This gritty and romantic series explores a seminal episode in South African history.
title: Blood River

overview: Paris 1972. Eva and Manuel make love in an attic when the French gendarmerie breaks down the door and forcibly takes the girl away to be deported to her country of origin. Marbella 1985. Nicole has married Manuel and has become a powerful woman, owner of the Marbella nightlife and the fashionable nightclub, Nicole's. She has managed to gather the entire jet. Everything points to a perfect night, but the arrival of a stranger surprises everyone: it is Eva.
title: Eva & Nicole

overview: Godiva's is a comedic drama about a fast-paced restaurant named Godiva's set in Yaletown, Vancouver, Canada. Add a little bit of Sex and the City and poof!, you got yourself Godiva's. Godiva's is named after the restaurant owner Godiva but she never appears on screen. Kate is the new manager of the restaurant and she tries to keep the restaurant afloat while dealing with problems with the restaurant and problems with the head chef Ramair.
title: Godiva's

overview: Commissioner Katharina Tempel is moving from the LKA to the criminal investigation department in Hamburg. Under the leadership of her new superior, Chief Inspector Georg König, she begins the murder investigation in the Hanseatic city. She is supported by her new colleague Dela Tahiri, her husband Volker, the celebrated press spokesman for the Hamburg police, and her best friend and prosecutor Golda Hopkins.
title: Ein Fall für Katharina Tempel

overview: Nine snapshots during the day of nine women of different ages who live in the same Parisian building without necessarily knowing each other, who desire, dare, doubt, amuse and touch us.
title: Neuf Meufs

overview: Between patients, doctors and private life, the 4 nurses of H24 take up new challenges every day in the surgical emergencies of Fleming Hospital.
title: H24

overview: Bête noire presents the side effects of an unforgivable act committed by Jérémy, a 16-year-old teenager. With the help of the investigating psychiatrist-coroner, his mother tries to figure out how her son, a seemingly trouble-free boy, came to commit an act of hate. What was the trigger for this nightmare? When did everything change? Together, the two women make it their mission to unravel the mystery of Jérémy.
title: Bête noire

overview: Têtard wants to be the initiatory journey of these two parents in the making, awaiting this unidentified object which is their unborn child.
title: Têtard

overview: He was at the top of the charts, but now he's at the bottom of the scale... Mike is a singer who had a fleeting glory in the early 2000s: he sold a million singles of his song "Dis-le moi en face," a very trendy French pop tune. But since then his inspiration, his fans and his savings have all left him.
title: Mike

overview: Augusto Castro can't stand the thought of his only sister Alice getting hitched to some monster man due to an old-school marriage pact from 15 years back. He decides to pull a fast one on the agreement and steps in to marry the notorious mob boss, Pietro, in her place. Little did he know, it was all a love trap set by Pietro.
title: The Mafia's Obsession

overview: It follows a delivery boy for fictional home-delivery app Enjoy!, who lands a dream job as an intern on a 24-hour news channel with a reactionary editorial line. His destiny soon collides with Igor, an ambitious young lawyer who dreams of defending great cases.
title: Enjoy !

overview: A three minute comedic look at a major celebrity's life and work
title: Tout est vrai (ou presque)

overview: Gioia is 16 years old: full adolescence, a terrible period for everyone. But she is also affected by all the changes that her mother, Sabrina, young and beautiful, forces her to face.
title: Eppure cadiamo felici

overview: Carly Shay led a pretty normal life... until she and her friends started their own web show. When iCarly becomes an instant hit, Carly and her pals have to balance their newfound success with the problems of everyday life. With her parents overseas, Carly relies on the help of her best friend/co-star, Sam, her longtime pal/technical producer, Freddie, and her eccentric older brother/guardian, Spencer, to keep it all together. Sam and Freddie's constant bickering and Spencer's odd habits make for a lot of good material...but is it enough to fill a new show every week?
title: iCarly

overview: Detective Superintendent Wycliffe heads an investigating team of officers brought in to solve the most intriguing of murder cases on the magnificent and windswept Cornish coast in the far South-West of England.
title: Wycliffe

overview: Inspired by twenty-four real facts, a series written by twenty-four European authors who chronicle violence against women on a daily basis, from the most banal incident to the most terrible tragedy. Twenty-four daring films interpreted by twenty-four exceptional actresses.
title: H24 , 24 heures de la vie d'une femme

overview: Marie and Loulou move away from the deafening noise of the city. While Loulou dreams of self-sufficiency, Marie wonders how she will be able to meet her professional commitments and have an exciting social life.
title: Gazebo

overview: A group of four thieves from the cities pull off a masterful blow and steal millions of euros in gold bars. How to dispose of this nest egg which stirs up all covetousness? The owners of the gold, the city bosses, the local mafia gangs, the more or less crooked police, everyone wants to recover the treasure and everyone is looking for them.
title: Or noir

overview: The side effect is Anouk, Marco, Fanny, Alex, Safa, Emma, Ahmed and many others who are going through high school with their heads filled with plans, doubts and intense emotions! It is also the effect of friendships that transform, unexpected rivalries, loves that are born, adults who take up too much space and trials that weaken. In the corridors of the school as in the courtyards, people stick together and confront each other, have fun and intimidate each other ... In short, it's everyday life, with its ups and downs, turned in a way rhythmic - in the manner of docurality - to capture hyper spontaneous slices of life.
title: L'Effet secondaire
Qu'est-ce qu'on attend pour être heureux ?

overview: Challenge Anneka is a British television programme, produced by the independent production company Mentorn for the BBC, which aired on Friday, later Saturday evenings on BBC One between 8 September 1989 and 15 October 1995. It was announced in 2006 that the series was returning, but this time on ITV. The first of the two specials was shown on Boxing Day 2006. The second transmitted in June 2007. The format of Challenge Anneka involved Anneka Rice being given a task to accomplish within a certain period of time, usually two or three days. She was supposed to have no knowledge of what the task of each particular episode would be before it began, and would have to organise its accomplishment by persuading companies and people to contribute their time and resources for free. The task would usually be in aid of a charitable cause, for example building a play area for children within the local community, or something similar.
title: Challenge Anneka

overview: The journey of a Latin-speaking Roman who has traveled through time from Ancient Rome until Nîmes (France) in 2018.
title: Nemausus

overview: It's The OC in the Old West as we dig deep into the untold story of the teens of the Pioneer Era. Meet Boy, a 13-year old underdog dreamer who hopes to be the world's first hang-WOMAN executioner. Together with her fellow teens, they live it up before they have to grow up, get married, and get killed...at the ripe age of fifteen.
title: Townies

overview: And if the monsters actually existed, but you did not know? Ed, Prof, Stan and Wallace take care of limiting the damage to their manners. They work for the underground organization Zone 42, which provides them with everything they need to carry out their missions.
title: Zone 42

overview: Melanie, a young woman who seemed to have everything, lost everything in her life. Just because driving through a tunnel with a 'time distortion' caused her life clock to disappear for a year! Everything she ever had, everything she ever got But her life was changed. It was someone's fault that caused it to be so. She received a 'special thing' instead of an apology, a 'watch necklace' that can turn time forward or backward five times. But with one condition, if she wants to change the date, she must 'kill' one life to use it to get through.
title: Time Mun Wela Tai

overview: Jeroen van Koningsbrugge explores abandoned structures and buildings in remote places that few people normally visit. With the help of expert Bob Thissen he investigates the stories, and sometimes shocking history, behind these mysterious locations.
title: Jeroen's Abandoned Adventures

overview: Khanak a simple, spirited young woman, living in village Dhulwadi, Bhuj , is newly married to her sweetheart, Suraj. In a tragic accident, Suraj is killed. The man who caused Suraj's death is Shantanu Khandelwal , the younger son of a business tycoon called Sunil Khandelwal. Under pressure from the village council (panchayat) of Dhulwadi, Shantanu marries Khanak and takes her to his home in the city. Khanak struggles to adjust to the unfamiliar environment, while Shantanu learns to accept his responsibilities. Meanwhile, Shantanu's arrogant mother Madhavi and sister-in- law Khushboo conspire to separate him from Khanak. This does not happen and Shaan and Khanak fall in love in the end.However, despite it all Khanak joins the family bond watch the family blossom their love and care for each other.
title: Rang Badalti Odhani

overview: When Zoey and Kiki, two irrepressible girls from another galaxy become castaways in the quiet, Australian seaside town of Lightning Point, they recruit local girl Amber to keep them undercover. But the whole town is abuzz with the sighting of UFOs and the girls soon realise that they may not be the first intergalactic visitors.
title: Lightning Point

overview: All The President's Men: A six-part series exposing the Deep State's coordinated attack on Trump supporters, revealing untold stories of personal sacrifice, political corruption, and the fight to preserve American democracy.
title: All the President's Men: The Conspiracy Against Trump

overview: Gaspard Berthille is the director of Tout-Paris, a famous cabaret that maintains the myth of wild Parisian nights. But unlike his father, Dary, Gaspard has not been able to perpetuate the reputation of the establishment. The arrival of a new investor, accompanied by his son, will shake up Gaspard and profoundly change the lives and destinies of the entire Tout-Paris team.
title: Ça, c'est Paris

overview: Throughout this compelling four-part docuseries, music being the ultimate connector is explored in the chronicled journey to create the world's first Israeli-Palestinian pop group. Over a five year period, the band members share their ups and downs including the challenging audition process in 2020; their language barriers, intense rehearsals, emotional highs and lows as they found their footing; navigating the very unexpected world events that happened on October 7th, 2023 – the morning after they flew to LA to record their first album; and the monumental challenges they have faced each day since. With so much more at stake because of the war, the band finds greater purpose in their music now representing something much greater than the six of them. The docuseries will also feature original music from the group including their debut single, "All Eyes On Us," featuring Nile Rodgers as well as their upcoming single, "Stranger," due this Friday, Nov. 15, and more.
title: as1one: The Israeli-Palestinian Pop Music Journey

overview: This true crime docuseries examines the murder of Annie Mae Aquash – a Mi'kmaq woman from Nova Scotia, Canada, a mother of two daughters, a teacher, and a revolutionary who fought for Indigenous rights in the 1970s whose death went unsolved for almost 30 years. Set between the sweeping landscape of American politics in the volatile 70s and the present-day investigation by Annie Mae's daughter to uncover secrets from the past, this is a fascinating story of murder, intrigue, love, and betrayal that contextualizes Annie Mae's story within the larger story of the struggle of Native and First Nations women in their own communities that continues even today.
title: Vow of Silence: The Assassination of Annie Mae
